content:
Hi everyone.
Want to share leetproof.org, a platform where you can practice Lean 4 by solving challenges. It targets beginners who are learning theorem proving. After solving a problem user can browse others solutions to learn new tactics and approaches, and share her own as well. For some problems there are step by step hints available if you get stuck. The website itself was built with help from Claude, but all problem contents was written by human. I tried to cover a broad range of topics from math and CS when picking problems. leetproof targets beginners, but if you are more experienced and think of a problem that would be interesting and useful for beginners, you are welcome to suggest it or open a PR at https://github.com/formalica/leetproof.
Feedbacks are welcome.
